'''Undrarian''' was a [[Krikthasi]] [[junieuw]] on the planet [[Baralou]]. The territory covered thousands of square kilometers and contained over 20 individual tribes. Undrarian was also the location of the [[Magl'Ikkan Temple]]. [[Osi]] [[Hass]] led the Undrarian territory during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was on friendly terms with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agent [[Fez Devvol]], commander of [[Aqualis Base]].
